summary: VectorGrid VPC pilot: BYO-KMS integration, SCIM seat provisioning and procurement approval
business_justification: Evaluate VectorGrid's vector search managed service for low-latency semantic search. Pilot will validate VPC PrivateLink performance, BYO-KMS encryption, and SCIM provisioning for automated seat lifecycle before committing to Dedicated deployment or multi-year contract.
security_reqs: SOC2 Type II report requested; vendor must support BYO-KMS (AWS KMS or external HSM), provide DPA with EU data residency controls, and complete a mini pen-test questionnaire. Network requirement: PrivateLink + egress control via customer-managed NAT.
legal_reqs: Standard Redwood SaaS Addendum + indemnity clause adjustments; require data processing terms, export compliance language, and termination assistance for data export. Legal flagged need for 45-day review window.
description:
Issue summary: Procurement and technical onboarding for a 12-month VectorGrid managed service pilot. Impact: Data Platform and Search teams need a private, encrypted vector store to replace a fragile in-house proxy. Goal: Provision 15 seats, configure SCIM, validate BYO-KMS key wrapping, and test PrivateLink connectivity in staging/us-west.

Scope: This ticket covers procurement approval, security & legal signoffs, infra playbook, and SCIM onboarding runbook. Post-pilot decision will route to Sourcing for enterprise negotiation if successful.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Receive vendor SOW and invoice draft. 2) Provision temporary test account under VectorGrid staging tenant. 3) Create KMS key in test AWS account and provide vendor with wrapped key/credentials for BYO-KMS flow. 4) Configure PrivateLink endpoint and run synthetic latency tests. 5) Enable SCIM and invite 3 pilot users to validate provisioning. 6) Validate data export and deletion flow.
logs_and_artifacts: Latency test results saved: s3://redwood-infra/experiments/vectorgrid/pilot-latency-20260311.csv; network capture snippet: /var/tmp/vg-private-link-trace-0311.pcap; vendor SOW PDF attached in Confluence page. Security questionnaire link in Confluence.
investigation_notes:
- Initial token exchange flow failed due to vendor expecting header 'x-client-id' (their docs outdated). Vendor acknowledged bug; fix delivered in staging on 2026-03-11.
- BYO-KMS handshake succeeded after updating grant policy; however, vendor's HSM integration requires key alias naming convention that conflicts with our org-wide policy; Security proposing a scoped grant instead of renaming keys.
- SCIM provisioning mapping needs custom attribute 'redwoodRole' to map to internal teams; Engineering will supply mapping file (PR referenced).
- PrivateLink ping RTT: median 9ms, 95th 18ms — acceptable for pilot.
